主要内容: Bloomberg Intelligence analysts have identified 50 publicly traded companies out of the 6,000 they track that are worth special attention in 2018. These companies are selected due to their plans to release significant products or services in the coming year or because they face unusual challenges. The selection process also considered factors such as revenue growth, profit margin, market share, and debt. The methodology for compiling the figures was based on the most recent company and/or broker reports as of September 15, unless otherwise noted. Estimated sales growth and EPS growth were calculated based on Bloomberg surveys of analysts. The data is presented in U.S. dollars, with N/M indicating not meaningful. The list includes companies such as Advanced Micro Devices Inc., Alaska Air Group, AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc., AT&T Inc., and Tesla Inc., among others. The report was edited by Dimitra Kessenides and Jillian Goodman.
